The '''Peach''' is a [[Fruits|fruit]] grown by planting a [[Peach Sapling]], waiting 28 days for it to grow into a [[Peach Tree]], and harvesting the tree during the [[Summer]].

A Peach may be purchased at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|140}} or found in [[The Cave|The Farm Cave]], if the fruit bat option is chosen.

==Recipes==
Peach is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Peach can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring#Pants|Relaxed Fit Shorts]]. [[File:Relaxed Fit Shorts.png|36px]] It also can be used as a red dye color in the Dye Pots, found inside [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
